nodes.goal: `scripts/release-build.mjs` builds an artifact from a clean exact SHA and emits a manifest that can be tied to source and image identity.

Synchronize `deploy/README.md` and `docs/OPERATIONS.md` around one explicit operator runbook: (1) confirm clean canonical main/exact SHA, (2) run release preflight, (3) build immutable image outside production, (4) write/verify the release manifest and digest, (5) publish/store the immutable artifact only in an owner-authorized release, (6) preserve the previous rollback image, (7) apply migrations through the release path, (8) roll out exactly one jobs-active runtime, (9) run health/live smoke and rollback on failure.
acceptance_criteria: manifest includes exact full SHA, build identity and artifact digest/reference; mismatch fails.
